metadata.title: llms.txt Analysis & Generation
metadata.description: Analyzes and generates llms.txt files, the emerging standard for helping AI systems understand website structure and content. Can validate existing llms.txt files or generate new ones from scratch by crawling the site. (Lite edition for workshop use.)
metadata.author: BIQDADDY

configuration.purpose: Handle everything related to the llms.txt standard, analyze existing files or generate new ones to help AI systems understand a site's structure and content.

why_llmstxt_matters.description: A convention proposed by Jeremy Howard in September 2024 that lets a site hand AI systems a curated Markdown index. Analogous to robots.txt but describes what is most useful rather than what is off limits. Cheap to produce, so it stays a deploy file; it is not a visibility lever.
benefits: Faster AI comprehension from a single file instead of crawling dozens of pages, for any reader that opens it
Controlled narrative: the site chooses which pages and facts appear first
Higher citation accuracy where a reader uses it: the correct authoritative page is named explicitly
Low cost: generated in minutes from the sitemap and client profile

facts: Google's AI features documentation states that no new machine-readable files or AI text files are needed to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode; Google's Gary Illyes said Google does not use llms.txt (Search Central Live, 2025)
Ahrefs (2026): of about 38,000 domains with a valid llms.txt, 97 percent received zero requests for the file in May 2026; 28 percent of 137,000 studied domains publish one
SE Ranking (2025-11-07, 300,000 domains): no statistically significant correlation between having llms.txt and how often a domain is cited in AI answers
No major platform (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Apple) has committed to reading it
evidence_status_2026.consequence: llms.txt is a hygiene item on every platform card and in the page checklist; it is never the reason a site is or is not cited.
evidence_status_2026.reporting_rule: Every llms.txt verdict in a card, report or recommendation carries the badge: adoption evidence low, hygiene item. Never describe it as read by Claude, ChatGPT or Perplexity.

required_elements.title: # Site Name, first line, H1 format, official business or site name
required_elements.description: > Brief description, blockquote format, under 200 characters, factual and specific
required_elements.main_sections: At least one H2 section (## Docs, ## Products, ## Services, and so on)

specification.page_entry_format: - [Page Title](URL): Description of page content (10-30 words, absolute URLs, ordered by importance, 10-30 entries total)
specification.key_facts_section: Recommended, founded year, headquarters, customer count, key products, industry classification
specification.contact_section: Recommended, website, email, support, phone, address

differences.descriptions: 30-100 words per entry with key facts

step_3_assess_quality.completeness: Covers all major site sections? Most important pages included? Key Facts present?
step_3_assess_quality.accuracy: Descriptions accurate? URLs valid? Key Facts verifiable?
step_3_assess_quality.usefulness: Would an AI understand the site from this file alone? Descriptions specific enough?

analysis_mode.step_4_compare_against_site: Crawl navigation and sitemap. Identify important pages not in llms.txt. Check for broken URLs. Verify description matches homepage. Flag stale entries.

generation_mode.step_1_site_discovery: Fetch homepage: extract site name, description, navigation links, footer links. Fetch sitemap. Identify business type.
generation_mode.step_3_write_descriptions: 10-30 words, factual (not marketing), states what information is on the page, mentions specific topics, data, or features
generation_mode.step_4_compile_key_facts: Year founded, founder names, headquarters, employees, customers, key products, industry, notable clients, key differentiators, recent milestones
generation_mode.step_5_assemble_file: Fill business_template below. It is the only template in this edition, use it for every business type and adapt the section names to the site.
generation_mode.step_6_validate: Verify all URLs reachable, 10-30 entries, no description exceeds 50 words, 50-150 lines, clean Markdown

analysis_sections: Quality assessment across completeness, accuracy, and usefulness
output.generation_mode: Output complete llms.txt file content plus {domain}_llmstxt_{YYYY-MM-DD}.md report

best_practices: Update regularly, monthly for active blogs, quarterly for stable sites
Lead with strongest content, first entries should be most authoritative
Be specific in descriptions, write '3,000-word guide with code examples' not 'React guide'
Include differentiators, unique data, original research, exclusive features
Keep it concise, scannable in under 60 seconds
Use absolute URLs, always full https://
Test after deployment, verify accessible with no redirects
Coordinate with robots.txt, pages in llms.txt should not be blocked
Mirror site structure, sections correspond to main navigation
Avoid sensitive pages, no internal tools, admin panels, or sensitive info
